task.title: Accept options between TARGET and PATTERN
task.problem: argparse rejected `bst-source-grep TARGET -n PATTERN` with 'unrecognized arguments: PATTERN', so grep-style option placement failed. Found when the benchmark's output-fanout scenario failed on main.
task.proposal: Parse with parse_intermixed_args so options may appear before, between or after positionals; `--` still allows patterns that start with '-'.
acceptance: TARGET -n PATTERN, -n TARGET PATTERN and TARGET PATTERN -n parse identically.
Existing invalid combinations still exit 2 with the semantic error.
